title: ±inf in variance, correlation and Kahan sums
description: Any ±inf input makes `var_*`, `stddev_*` and `corr` NaN: the update computes `inf - inf`. `fsum` and `favg` of `[inf, 1]` are NaN, while `sum` and `avg` are `inf`.
One value: `var_samp` is NULL, `var_pop` 0, `corr(x, x)` NaN.
reference: `AggFn.var` and `AggFn.corr` of the same rows; the reference's handling of ±inf in these aggregates is part of #85.

provenance.checked_by: coordinator subagent of session local_974f7865 (aggregate-algorithms research)
provenance.notes: Read at tag v2.0.0 (commit d54cbbe3). Why the result is NaN, read from the update.

provenance.checked_by: the coordinator's subagent, and this session again, in python/'s DuckDB 2.0.0

evidence.sql: SELECT var_samp(x), stddev_samp(x), corr(x, x) FROM (VALUES ('inf'::DOUBLE), (1.0), (2.0)) t(x)
SELECT sum(x), fsum(x), favg(x), avg(x) FROM (VALUES ('inf'::DOUBLE), (1.0)) t(x)
SELECT var_samp(x), var_pop(x), corr(x, x) FROM (VALUES (1.0::DOUBLE)) t(x)
